🟦 EVENING NEWS RECAP — February 23, 2026

⭕️ BREAKING —

• President Trump says General Daniel Caine believes a war against Iran would be “easily won,” directly contradicting media reports of Pentagon resistance.

• The U.S. State Department issues a DO NOT TRAVEL warning for Lebanon and evacuates some staff.

• The USS Gerald R. Ford arrives at Souda Bay, Greece, reinforcing U.S. naval posture in the eastern Mediterranean.

UNITED STATES —

• Secretary of State Marco Rubio is still planning to travel to Israel, though officials say the schedule remains fluid.

• The Pentagon privately warns the White House that an extended Iran campaign could strain U.S. forces and air defenses.

• U.S. Southern Command strikes a drug-trafficking vessel in the Caribbean, killing three suspected narco-terrorists with no U.S. casualties.

• Nick Reiner pleads not guilty to two first-degree murder charges in the killing of his parents, film director Rob Reiner and his wife, Michelle. Reiner appeared in court not looking well.

ISRAEL —

• Prime Minister Netanyahu warns that any Iranian attack on Israel would trigger a response “with a force they cannot even imagine.”

• Israel converts underground levels of a Tel Aviv hospital into a fortified emergency medical facility in preparation for a major crisis.

MIDDLE EAST —

• Brave students protest and chant against the regime in Tehran during renewed calls for the fall of the mullahs.

• USS Gerald R. Ford seen in Crete.

• U.S. intelligence assesses growing signs Iran could direct proxy attacks against American targets in Europe and the Middle East if strikes are ordered.

• Major oil companies advise staff across six Gulf states to avoid all non-essential travel.

EUROPE —

• Pope Leo XIV privately warns Spain’s senior bishops that the country’s greatest threat is the growing far right and cautions against politicizing the Church.

• An RC-135 Rivet Joint surveillance aircraft lands at RAF Mildenhall after an unusually long flight from Japan, adding to heightened NATO ISR activity.

TECH & WARFARE —

• Anduril unveils “Fury,” America’s first autonomous fighter jet, highlighting rapid advances in AI-driven air combat.

• Battlefield footage showcases swarm-based defense systems, underscoring the shift toward autonomous warfare.

GLOBAL —

• Mayon Volcano erupts in the Philippines, prompting emergency monitoring.

• Peru reports at least 15 dead following a military helicopter crash.

That’s your Evening News Recap. Like, comment, share and repost.
